sn22.86:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kuṭāgārasālāyaṃ || || 2
sn22.86:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Anurādho Bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharati || || 3
sn22.86:1.3: Atha kho sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāyasmā Anurādho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Anurādhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu ||
sn22.86:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 4 Ekam antaṃ nīsinnā kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantam Anurādham etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.86:1.5: Yo so āvuso Anurādha tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tāthāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññāpeti || ||
sn22.86:1.6: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇa ti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || || 5
sn22.86:2.1: Evaṃ vutte Anurādho te aññatitthiye paribbājake etad avoca || ||
sn22.86:2.2: Yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññāpeti || ||
sn22.86:2.3: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 6
sn22.86:2.4: Evaṃ vutte te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantam Anurādham etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.86:2.5: So cāyam bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito || thero vā pana bālo avyatto ti || || 7
sn22.86:2.6: Atha kho aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantam Anurādham navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmiṃsu || || 8
sn22.86:3.1: Atha kho āyasmato Anurādhassa acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etad ahosi || ||
sn22.86:3.2: Sa ce kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ pañham puccheyyuṃ ||
sn22.86:3.3: kathaṃ vyākaramāno nu khvāhaṃ tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva Bhagavato assaṃ na ca Bhagavantam abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyyaṃ na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgaccheyyāti || || 9
sn22.86:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Anurādho yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || la || || 10 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Anurādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.86:4.2: Idhāhaṃ bhante Bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharāmi || ||
sn22.86:4.3: Atha kho bhante sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || la || mam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.86:4.4: Yo so āvuso Anurādha tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññāpeti
sn22.86:4.5: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || pe ||
sn22.86:4.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti vā ti || || 11
sn22.86:5.1: Evam vuttāham bhante te aññatitthiye paribbājake etad avoca || ||
sn22.86:5.2: Yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāyamāno paññāpeti
sn22.86:5.3: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || pe ||
sn22.86:5.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 12
sn22.86:5.5: Evaṃ vutte bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbajakā mam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.86:5.6: So cāyam bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito thero vā pana bālo avyatto ti || || 13
sn22.86:5.7: Atha kho mam bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu || || 14
sn22.86:6.1: Tassa mayham bhante acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etad ahosi || ||
sn22.86:6.2: Sa ce kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbajakā uttariṃ pañham puccheyyuṃ ||
sn22.86:6.3: kathaṃ vyākaramāno nu khvāhaṃ tesam aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānam vuttavādī ceva Bhagavato assaṃ na ca Bhagavantam abbhācikkheyyaṃ dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyyaṃ na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgaccheyyāti || || 15
sn22.86:7.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.86:9.12: Viññāṇasmiṃ tathāgato ti samanupassasīti || || No hetam bhante || ||
sn22.86:11.2: ayaṃ so arūpī avedano asaññī asaṅkhāro aviññāṇo tathāgato ti samanupassasīti || ||
sn22.86:12.1: Ettha ca te Anurādha diṭṭhevadhamme saccato thetato tathāgato anupalabbhiyamāno || kallaṃ nu te taṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ
sn22.86:12.2: Yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññāpeti
sn22.86:12.3: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || na hoti || hoti ca na ca hoti || neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || ||
sn22.86:13.2: pubbe cāham Anurādha etarahi ca dukkhañceva paññāpemi dukkhassa ca nirodhanti || || 1
